proposals.rationale: braces <=3.0.3 has no patched release (advisory checked 2026-10-03). The only installed path is the ESLint config for Next.js; the latest and canary @next/eslint-plugin-next releases still pin fast-glob@3.3.1, and npm's only suggested fix is a semver-major downgrade to eslint-config-next@14.2.35.
proposals.exposureEvidence: Development-only (lockfile dev: true on every package in the path, root devDependency edge). @next/eslint-plugin-next calls fast-glob only from getRootDirs when settings.next.rootDir is set; eslint.config.mjs does not set it. braces/micromatch/fast-glob are absent from the Next standalone output, the esbuild video-worker bundle and next/dist/compiled. No catalogue, menu or customer input reaches it. Residual risk: a change to the lint configuration could crash the lint process (denial of service of a CI step).
removalConditions: The resolved braces version is verified as not affected by GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.
The eslint-config-next > @next/eslint-plugin-next > fast-glob > micromatch > braces path is removed from package-lock.json.
The exception reaches expiresAt (it then stops applying automatically).
